annotations.title: Get a custom reproduction price quotation (no catalog artwork needed)

description: Price quotation for a CUSTOM reproduction — one made from an image the customer supplies (their own photo, or an artwork that is not in the catalog) — as an art print or a hand-painted oil painting. No artwork identification is needed or accepted: the price depends only on the size, the reproduction type and the currency. Use this whenever the artwork cannot be found in the catalog (the search tools return nothing relevant, or get_a_quotation fails with artwork_not_found), or the customer wants their own picture reproduced. Optional frame_code ("WhiteWrap" = stretched on stretcher bars, "default" = a decorative frame chosen for you, or a catalog code) adds the frame price to quotation_price; optional senior_artist (oil painting only) adds the "Elite Senior Artist" upgrade — more detail and finesse, extra production time. Each side must be 25-250 cm (about 10-98 inches). Returns quotation_price (the base price: options chosen on the order form, like varnish or urgent delivery, cost extra — see "notes"), currency, frame_code (+ frame_description, frame_delivery), width_cm/height_cm, notes, and order_page_url — the page where the customer uploads their image and orders the reproduction. Give order_page_url to the user as the link to place this order. For a hand-painted portrait the price covers up to 3 faces; the per-extra-face surcharge is stated in notes.

frame_code.description: Optional frame; when set, quotation_price includes it. Omit it (or "NoFrame") for the canvas rolled in a tube. "WhiteWrap" = the canvas stretched on wooden stretcher bars, white edges, no outer frame (use it for any request for a stretcher, stretcher bars, a stretched canvas or a canvas ready to hang without a frame); "BlurSideWrap" / "ExtendedWrap" = the same with the image blurred / continued around the edges. "default" = a decorative outer frame chosen for you (the frame recommended for the artwork when it has one, else our best-selling frame) — use it to quote a framed option without knowing the catalog. Any other catalog code (e.g. "P118B", "P919G", "W316G", "H24-GOLD-Portrait") is that specific decorative frame. The result then carries frame_description, frame_delivery (assembled, or a disassembled kit over 105 cm) and, for "default", frame_chosen_by. The customer selects that frame on the order form (notes says which).

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

senior_artist.description: Oil painting only: have an Elite Senior Artist paint it (more detail, finesse and extra production time). When true, quotation_price includes the upgrade; the customer selects the option on the order form.
